integrity: Exact gapwise Motzkin bijections for prescribed square-root fibers; bivariate generating function and analytic moment proof of the conditioned Rayleigh law. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The unweighted Motzkin INVERT total and scalar asymptotic are known (OEIS A005773). Full 2015 Laradji–Umar article and 1992 Umar thesis chapters remain priority risks. Applicable only to injective order-preserving extensive partial maps.
title: Motzkin square-root fibers and a Rayleigh fixed-point law in injective partial Catalan monoids
